blenheimchalcot-blenheimchalcot:greenhou.description: Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter. Trusted by leading brands across three continents, including Callaway Golf, TravelPro and Laura Geller, Fospha manages $4 billion in annual ad spend. We're scaling fast across London, Mumbai, and Austin – and we're now looking for Talent to join us across our Customer Teams. The Role Driving onboarding speed and quality — you'll be the person making sure clients get value fast, and get it right Managing post-go-live implementation requests for our enterprise and growth clients, configuring changes to their live systems Querying our database - learning SQL to query Client’s data and solve problems (no previous experience required!). Getting hands-on with the product — assessing, configuring, and troubleshooting client account setups using your growing technical knowledge Spotting risk early — flagging anything that could threaten adoption or renewal before it becomes a problem Building real relationships — you'll be on client calls regularly, and confident, clear communication will become second nature Working cross-functionally — partnering with Account Management, Partnerships, Marketing Science and Product and your wider team to keep everyone aligned on onboarding progress Using AI to work smarter — we actively want you experimenting with our Gen AI tools to find better, faster ways of working In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen AI hub to increase our efficiency The Centre of Excellence The Centre of Excellence is Fospha's early-careers programme that develops ambitious, high-performing talent through focused training, hands-on experience and cross-functional exposure. Starting in Customer Teams, you'll gain foundational experience while being prepared for future opportunities across the organisation. The programme operates on the following principles: Individual Responsibility from the Get-go: You will quickly be responsible for the success of your work, able to make an individual impact early in your career Work alongside SLT at Leading Businesses: You will be engaging with Senior Leadership and C-Level executives at the leading retail brands, getting exposure to how the top companies operate Become a Customer Facing Expert: You will be working directly with customers, often meeting them in person and developing your ability to create strong interpersonal relationships Cross-Functional Exposure: we offer unique opportunities to learn from and collaborate with every department in the business — many daily Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Account Management, Market Research & Product and Financial Management Real Mentorship: Regular one-to-ones, feedback, and career conversations with people invested in your progression, not just your output Career Development: High performers have clear opportunities to quickly advance their careers at Fospha — whether progressing within Customer Teams toward strategic and/or management roles or moving into other departments that align with their skills and interests Modern Tools: Hands-on exposure to Gen AI tooling through our Gen AI hub, so you're building modern, AI-fluent ways of working rather than legacy processes What we’re looking for: Curious, proactive individuals who are keen to learn and grow Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong relationship-building ability, both internally and externally Analytical mindset, comfortable interpreting data and creating insights – proficiency in Excel! cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:9a9.team: 174 - Bradley Fair - Sur La Table, 2142 N. Rock Rd., Space D, Wichita, KS 67206
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:9a9.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Kitchen Assistant at Sur La Table, you play a key role in inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. With a passion for cooking, hospitality, and teamwork, the Kitchen Assistant supports the chefs to ensure smooth class operations and a #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. You’ll help bring culinary dreams to life by supporting our chefs, engaging with guests, and ensuring a clean, well-organized kitchen environment. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist chefs with class execution that drives repeat visits and positive customer feedback · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to demonstrate, retrieve and/or replenish merchandise and/or cooking equipment. · Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to chop, whisk, slice, stir, juice and/or demonstrate other techniques. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise

jobgether-jobgether:lever:25a098ae-3e29-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Back End Engineer – Sportsbook based in United Kingdom. This is a senior engineering opportunity to help build a brand-new Sportsbook platform from the ground up. You will play a key role in shaping the backend architecture, technical foundations, and engineering practices behind a global gaming product. The position covers the full software development lifecycle, from understanding product requirements and system design through deployment, testing, and maintenance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to turn ambitious product ideas into scalable and reliable technical solutions. As a senior technical contributor, you will influence architectural decisions, improve system performance, and establish strong engineering standards. The environment is agile, fast-moving, and highly collaborative, offering substantial ownership over the technology being built. It is an opportunity to make a direct impact on a new Sportsbook product and help define its technical direction from day one. Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and efficient backend services for a new Sportsbook platform. Contribute to the end-to-end development lifecycle, from framing product requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Collaborate with product, engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical specifications. Lead architectural discussions and make informed technology decisions that improve scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability. Design and implement large-scale distributed systems capable of supporting a growing gaming platform. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues across backend services and production environments. Establish and promote software engineering best practices, coding standards, testing approaches, and code-review processes. Contribute to CI/CD practices and deployment automation to support reliable and efficient software delivery. Help shape the technical roadmap and architecture of the Sportsbook as the product evolves. Requirements: Proven experience building and launching a Sports betting application from scratch, with strong understanding of the technical requirements of Sportsbook platforms. 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in Java and/or Kotlin and Spring . Demonstrated experience designing and implementing large-scale software systems, particularly distributed and highly scalable backend systems. Strong understanding of backend architecture, system design, scalability, performance, and reliability. Hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-based application environments. Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues independently. Ability to lead technical discussions, influence architectural decisions, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively in an agile, cross-functional environment. Good command of English, equivalent to at least B2 level . Benefits: Opportunity to build a new Sportsbook platform from the ground up and directly influence its architecture and technology. High level of technical ownership and visibility across a new product initiative. Opportunity to work on large-scale, distributed backend systems and challenging engineering problems. Collaborative and agile working environment with cross-functional teams. Ability to shape engineering standards, architectural decisions, and development practices from an early stage. jobgether-jobgether:lever:4ba9cc40-9cfe-.title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4ba9cc40-9cfe-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Italy. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:c534d37f-3421-4ab0.title: Structural Steel CNC Operator
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:c534d37f-3421-4ab0.description: CNC Machine Operator Location: York, PA Job Type: Contract-to-Hire Shift: 2nd Shift Rate: Starting at $22.00/hour, plus a $3.00/hour night differential. Higher pay may be available based on experience.
responsibilities: Set up and operate CNC equipment, including plasma cutters, beam drill lines, and angle lines.
Review fabrication drawings, blueprints, and work orders to determine production requirements.
Load and secure steel beams, plates, and other materials using overhead cranes and rigging equipment.
Monitor equipment operation and make adjustments to maintain accuracy and quality.
Check dimensions and tolerances using tape measures, calipers, squares, and other precision measuring tools.
Make basic programming edits or machine adjustments for different material sizes and thicknesses.
Perform routine CNC maintenance and assist with troubleshooting.
Maintain a clean and safe work area while following OSHA and shop safety procedures.
qualifications: High school diploma or GED required; technical or trade school training preferred.
2+ years of CNC machine operation experience in structural steel fabrication or heavy manufacturing.
Ability to read and understand structural steel shop drawings.
Experience operating overhead cranes, forklifts, and rigging equipment preferred.
Strong mechanical aptitude and attention to detail.
Able to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: CRNA Opportunity The Specialty Alliance Ambulatory Surgery Center The Urology Group (TUG) —a premier, physician‑led practice and proud member of Urology Alliance —is seeking a skilled and motivated Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA) to join our growing outpatient surgery team. This is an exceptional opportunity to practice with autonomy, stability, and the support of one of the nation’s leading urology networks. Position Overview As a CRNA with The Urology Group, you will provide safe, high‑quality anesthesia care in a modern, fast‑paced outpatient surgical environment. You’ll work alongside experienced surgeons and clinical staff while enjoying a strong work‑life balance and a collaborative culture. Position Profile: 7 CRNA and 2 Physicians Generous Sign Package Competitive salary No Call - No Weekends – No Holidays Great coverage – Easy to take time away Quick easy cases Family environment – excellent culture Great location Key Responsibilities Perform all aspects of airway management and anesthesia delivery Manage patient emergence and recovery, including medication and fluid administration Monitor vital functions and respond promptly to adverse reactions Ensure timely termination of anesthesia to support smooth recovery Support overall surgical operations and perform additional duties as needed What We Offer Competitive compensation with comprehensive benefits Autonomous practice environment within a respected, physician‑led organization Advanced clinical resources , including cutting‑edge diagnostics and a premier outpatient surgery center Stable, long‑standing practice with 25+ years of excellence Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com .
